posts.text:
🪦 RIP 

🫟 Infinite Slop TV

August 2026 - October 2026

It let anybody on the internet write into a chat that fed into a perpetual stream of live generated AI video (aka slop)

It wasn't possible before that because there weren't AI video models yet that generated faster than they could be played, but then @fal hacked @MiniMax_AI's H3 to be so fast that it finally could! FAL also sponsored me to do this project because otherwise it would have costed me $200,000/mo in GPU cost, at least!

Here's some stats:

📈 17,800,000 clip views
💬 287,555 chat messages
❤️ 287,000 likes on clips
📺 210,196 AI clips aired
🛡 125,808 messages blocked by moderation 💀 (so about 44% was blocked!)
👀 185,000 visitors
💬 47,000 people made videos
⏱ 860 hours of never-repeating video
💰 3 sponsors: @sideshiftai + @creem_io + @chatbase

Paid out 3 prizes: 
🏆 $5000 to "67" (wanted to stay anon)
🪙 $2500 to @ssthormess (aka "SS" on the site)
🥉 $1000 to @tatusea_ ("tatusea" on the site)

In the end it didn't manage to keep catching attention though but it was a great little fun internet experiment

Lots of funny weird things happened, because each video generated would take cues from the previous (the AI would try keep some type of cohesion), you'd get these kind of trends keep going through videos. For awhile every video had goth girls, then slime girls, then pickles, then it'd turn into pixel art, and then people would spam it back to goth girls

There is something here though, but I'm not sure what it is, or how to make it work in the future. Slop is of course slop, and it is addictive but after awhile it also gets boring because it's still too basic. I can see that there will be interactive and personalized content in the future that's live generated and will work but we're not there yetttt

It's also a bit dystopian but utopian in other ways: live generated teachers explaining stuff to kids is awesome for example and I think I saw Minimax H3 Max used for that too

Anyway, everyone thanks for watching and creating! 🙏😊
posts.text_zh:
🪦 RIP

🫟 Infinite Slop TV

2026 年 8 月 - 2026 年 10 月

它让互联网上的任何人都可以往聊天里写内容，这些内容会进入一条永不停歇的实时生成 AI 视频流（也就是 slop）

以前这不可能，因为还没有生成速度快过播放速度的 AI 视频模型，但后来 @fal 把 @MiniMax_AI 的 H3 优化到足够快，终于做到了！FAL 还赞助了我做这个项目，否则光 GPU 成本每月至少要花掉我 $200,000！

一些数据：

📈 17,800,000 次片段播放
💬 287,555 条聊天消息
❤️ 片段收获 287,000 个赞
📺 播出了 210,196 个 AI 片段
🛡 125,808 条消息被审核拦截 💀（大约 44% 被拦了！）
👀 185,000 名访客
💬 47,000 人制作了视频
⏱ 860 小时从不重复的视频
💰 3 位赞助商：@sideshiftai + @creem_io + @chatbase

发放了 3 个奖项：
🏆 $5000 给了 "67"（希望保持匿名）
🪙 $2500 给了 @ssthormess（站上的 "SS"）
🥉 $1000 给了 @tatusea_（站上的 "tatusea"）

最后它没能持续抓住大家的注意力，但这次有趣的互联网小实验还是很棒

中间发生了很多又好笑又奇怪的事，因为每段生成的视频都会从上一段汲取线索（AI 会尽量保持某种连贯性），于是你会看到某种潮流在视频里延续。有一段时间每条视频都是哥特女孩，然后是史莱姆女孩，然后是泡菜，再变成像素艺术，接着人们又会刷回去要哥特女孩

这里面确实有些东西，但我还不确定那是什么，也不确定将来怎么把它做起来。slop 当然还是 slop，它让人上瘾，但过一段时间也会觉得无聊，因为它仍然太基础。我能想象未来会有实时生成的、可交互且个性化的内容，而且能跑起来，但我们现在还没到那一步ttt

这件事也有点反乌托邦，但从另一些角度看又很乌托邦：比如实时生成的老师给孩子们讲课就很棒，我好像也看到 Minimax H3 Max 被用在这方面

总之，谢谢大家观看和创作！🙏😊

i'm a solo dev and i built an infinitely evolving backrooms game and released it on the web. 

35,000 players and ~9,600 hours played. these are my metrics under 36 hours of launch.

🏩 Hotelist is now my most popular site with 700,000+ visitors per month

So I added user profiles today invite-only and invited @marckohlbrugge @jelmerdeboer @theannalux and they get 3 invites too so let's see who joins

Users can review and rate hotels, upvote/downvote other user's reviews and get karma from all of that

The idea is actually by Marc that you probably trust your friends' and their friends reviews better than random Google Maps reviews (which are also often fake)

So this is a natural social way to get rid of fake reviews, because you're probably far away from a fake reviewer and you trust your friends' reviews
quoted.text_zh:
🏩 Hotelist 现在是我最受欢迎的网站，每月访问量超过 70 万

所以我今天加上了邀请制用户主页，邀请了 @marckohlbrugge @jelmerdeboer @theannalux，他们各自也有 3 个邀请名额，看看谁会加入

用户可以点评和给酒店打分，给别人的评论点赞/点踩，并从中获得 karma

这个想法其实来自 Marc：比起随机的 Google Maps 评价（而且经常是假的），你大概更信任朋友以及朋友的朋友的评价

所以这是一种自然的社交方式来干掉假评，因为你和假评论者大概离得很远，而你信任朋友的评价
